name: analyze_references
description: Analyze a user message to detect references to previous conversations, historical data, or contextual information that would benefit from summary-aware processing.

has_references.description: True if the message contains references to previous conversations or historical context

confidence.description: Confidence level (0-100) in the reference detection analysis

reference_types.description: Types of references detected in the message

detected_phrases.description: Specific phrases that indicate references to historical context

reasoning.description: Brief explanation of why this message does or doesn't contain references
